description: Searches the Ad Radar library of Facebook and Instagram ads from the Meta Ad Library (every ad has at least $50k estimated spend), with the same filters as the Ad Radar board. By default it returns only active ads, sorted by score, as compact rows. Each row has an adKey, which get_ad and get_swipe_prompt accept. Valid tag dimensions and slugs are the ones list_taxonomy returns. headline and body are null when the ad's text isn't available (the tags still describe the ad); in rows they are cut at 140 and 280 characters, while get_ad returns them whole. Every other value in a row matches what get_ad returns for that ad. spendEstimate is an estimate based on engagement, not reported spend; spendLowerBound true means the value is a minimum ("at least").

advertiserId.description: Only ads of this advertiser (the advertiserId shown in search rows)

includePastWinners.description: Also include winners that are no longer running (archive)

media.description: Creative type: video, image (image and carousel ads) or all

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (results stop at 1,000 per query)

query.description: Free text over headline, body, advertiser name and transcript

sort.description: Order: score (Ad Radar score), reactions, rpd (reactions per day), days (days running) or recent (newest first)

tags.description: Taxonomy filters: { "<dimension>": ["slug", ...] }. Different dimensions are ANDed, slugs within one are ORed

tier.description: winner = top 10% by score and running 21+ days; rising = growing. Every ad on the radar has at least $50k estimated spend

name: search_ads
title: Search ads
